visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Read the number from one place
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The script writes the count into the page and also keeps a copy in a variable. Remove the variable and read the number back from the page instead. It must still count correctly.
visualizerParams.initialCode: 0

solution.code: 0
solution.explanation: Here the page is the single source of the number, so there is nothing to keep in step. For a bigger program a variable is usually the better home for state, and the page only displays it; both ways are good when used on purpose.
